subtitle: 写入工具前先过钩子，再等人批准：批准的是哪组参数，执行的就是哪组

question.zh-CN: 查看并修改 TKT-102，再通知负责人：只读调用直接放行，两次写入各等你批准一次。
question.en: Look at and update TKT-102, then notify its owner: read calls run at once, and each of the two writes waits for your approval.

question.zh-CN: 修改 TKT-103 并通知相关人员：拒绝群发通知，再让第二封通知等到超时，看模型怎样收场。
question.en: Update TKT-103 and notify the people concerned: reject the broadcast notice, then let the second notice time out, and see how the model wraps up.

question.zh-CN: 通知 TKT-104 的负责人：在审批卡上把收件人改成公司域名以外的地址，看钩子是否仍然拦下。
question.en: Notify the owner of TKT-104: edit the recipient on the approval card to an address outside the company domain and see whether the hooks still stop it.

question.zh-CN: 批准一封通知，但一个演示用的故障在批准之后改了收件人：看执行前的摘要核对能否拦下。
question.en: Approve one notice while a demo fault swaps the recipient after approval: see whether the digest check before execution stops it.

ui.question_help: 任务由结构化预设决定；这里的文字只记为备注，不会发给模型。写入类调用会先停在审批卡上等你决定；工单台是本次运行的临时目录，不会改动你的文件。
